name: Cirrus
source:
Cirrus (full name is Cirrus Amnera) – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change and an Azaries's father.
Cirrus is an adult blue-eyed bald om'verai with silver scales. Cheeks are covered with fins, surrounded by 2 horns each - short straight ones and longer light curved.

Belly plate are light and a back side of a head is covered by spikes. Cirrus' face is decorated with a glasses-like marking: his nose has a 'Y' marking, white eyebrows and 3 'drops' under each eye.

There are 6 horns on Cirrus' nape: 2 are curved aside up, 2 are shorter and resemble sickles. Nose and back are covered with big white spikes.
Cirrus is a quiet severus, but caring father and husband for both Azaries and Erandies respectively, often pampering his daughter. He is good in cooking, especially fried fathdogs’ legs. A quiet inattentive man.

Cirrus used to have an adventurer-like personality at childhood.
